turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I have about twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski. I know your schedule is brutal.
Don't manage my schedule, Hale. You've used up a minute of it already. I'm still waiting for an answer.
I have to say, you're far more reasonable than I expected. Most parents come in swinging.
Then why are we here? You entered a zero before speaking to me, and I want to know on what basis.
It's refreshing. You clearly see the whole picture, so I think we're really on the same side here.

We're not on the same side, Hale. Your own procedure says you call the parent before a mark goes in, and nobody called me. Withdraw the zero, or I'm going to the principal's office when we're done here.
